# Protocol Contract Checklist: Multi-Call Scorer Identity and Per-Item Error Semantics

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the scorer identity lists and the per-item error rule are complete,
unambiguous, and compatible, before and during PR review
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]`
only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does
not mean implementation work is complete.

## Deprecation and Fallback

- [ ] CHK001 Is the host read order (list first, then the deprecated single id) stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it explicit that the single-id and first-list-entry relationship is a SHOULD and is not validated,
  with a rationale? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the lifetime of the deprecated field stated (it survives at least one MAJOR version)? [Gap,
  Constitution VI]

## Primary Model Rule

- [ ] CHK004 Is the primary-model rule defined for all four combinations (model set or unset, list set or empty)?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the model list order defined beyond its first entry? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Per-Item Error Semantics

- [ ] CHK006 Is the rule against the unsupported-type flag stated as both a scorer MUST NOT and a validation
  outcome? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is host handling of an empty per-item message defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Cache Key Impact

- [ ] CHK008 Is it stated which new field joins the score cache key and which does not, with consistent reasoning
  for both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]

## Conformance and SDK Parity

- [ ] CHK009 Is each new rule mapped to a conformance failure condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the mock's recommended way of filling both lists specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Is TypeScript coverage defined beyond regenerated types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the boundary with the open scoring PRs (fields they use) documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and
  `/speckit-clarify`
